sign-in-sheet/note: Import a CSV name list to generate printable A4 portrait sign-in sheets, with optional phone/email masking, signature or checkbox sign-off, and automatic multi-page output.
sign-in-sheet/tags: sign in sheet, attendance sheet, sign up sheet, event, workshop, printable, A4, PDF
sign-in-sheet/settings/blank_rows_hint: Blank rows appended after the list for on-site walk-ins.
sign-in-sheet/csv/mapping_hint: Choose what each column is used for. Unmapped columns can still be printed as extra columns.
sign-in-sheet/csv/no_data: No data yet. Upload a file, paste content, or load the sample list.
sign-in-sheet/preview/empty: Import a CSV list or set the blank rows count to generate the sheet.
sign-in-sheet/preview/truncated: Too many rows: output is limited to the first 50 pages.
sign-in-sheet/features/csv_mapping_desc: Upload or paste a CSV roster, then map each column to name, phone, email, or extra printed columns.
sign-in-sheet/features/privacy_masking_d: Optionally mask phone numbers and email addresses on the printed sheet.
sign-in-sheet/features/sign_off_modes_de: Choose taller cells for handwritten signatures or a small box to tick off.
sign-in-sheet/features/multi_page_pdf_de: Rows are paginated automatically across A4 portrait pages; download a PDF or print directly.
sign-in-sheet/how_to_use/step1: Upload a CSV file or paste its content; the first row is used as the header.
sign-in-sheet/how_to_use/step2: Map columns to name, phone, email, or extra fields, and toggle masking as needed.
sign-in-sheet/how_to_use/step3: Fill in the sheet title, date and location, then choose signature or checkbox sign-off.
sign-in-sheet/how_to_use/step4: Check the paginated preview, then download the PDF or print it.
